description: This is a PHP class file defining the 'Multiplication' class within the 'Matrix\Operators' namespace. The class handles matrix and scalar multiplication operations for a matrix object, providing methods to execute multiplication with different operand types.

classes.name: Multiplication
classes.description: A class that performs multiplication operations on matrices or scalars, allowing chaining of operations.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs multiplication with a matrix or numeric value, returning the object for chaining.

methods.name: multiplyScalar
methods.description: Performs scalar multiplication on the matrix elements.

methods.name: multiplyMatrix
methods.description: Performs matrix multiplication with another Matrix object.
